verdict.rationale: Asana exposes a REST API and OpenAPI spec that could be used to export tasks/projects programmatically, which supports data portability, but there is no documented native 'export all data' or GDPR-style full account export feature, no mention of open standard export formats (CSV/JSON bulk export), and no evidence of a data portability policy for leaving the platform. missing for 10: dedicated bulk data export feature, documentation of export file formats, evidence of full account data portability/exit process, independent confirmation of export completeness.
